projects.name: Project COMPLAINCE
details: DESCRIPTION
Compliance domain application designed for organizations to manage and track their compliance readiness. The
application supports subscription-based access, allowing users to take assessments, upload relevant documents, and
receive AI-driven analysis to evaluate compliance levels and identify gaps. The system also facilitates automated
generation of policy documents based on assessment outcomes and uploaded content.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Gathered and analyzed client requirements and documented them in Functional Requirement
Documents (FRD) and Business Requirement Documents (BRD).
Translated requirements into user stories, use cases, and tasks for development and QA teams.
Facilitated requirement walkthroughs and ensured clear understanding across cross-functional teams.
Conducted manual testing of the application to validate features against defined requirements.
Managed and led daily stand-up meetings, ensuring effective team collaboration and progress tracking.
Handled Jira sprint planning, including backlog grooming, task assignment, and sprint reviews.
Participated in client meetings, gathered feedback, and ensured timely updates and revisions were
communicated to the team.

projects.name: Project E-PROCUREMENT
details: DESCRIPTION
Procure to Pay (P2P) is an integrated process that manages the procurement and payment of goods and services. It starts with
identifying needs and ends with payment to the supplier. Key steps include requisitioning, purchasing, receiving, invoicing,
and payment. This process aims to ensure efficiency, compliance, and cost-effectiveness in managing a company's
procurement activities.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements and ensure alignment with business needs.
Designed and executed automated test scripts using Selenium to streamline regression and functionality testing,
significantly reducing testing time.
Conducted thorough analysis of test results, identifying trends and areas for improvement to enhance
Product quality
Participated in user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate functionality against user requirements.

projects.name: TECHNOLOGY
details: DESCRIPTION
Worked on an experiential learning platform that bridges skill gaps for graduates by identifying industry- required skills and

designing tailored boot camps. It assesses college curricula to create bridge programs that up skill candidates according to employers' needs. Integrated with iCapability, iLearn, and iProductivity, the app allows users to register and enroll in skill-
building programs. Admins can add mentors, service providers, and create various programs.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Automated testing processes using Selenium and Python, improving testing accuracy and efficiency across
multiple iterations.
Integrated testing with APIs using Postman, ensuring the reliability and functionality of service interfaces.
Collaborated with product managers and developers to identify critical testing paths and enhance overall user
experience.
Facilitated feedback sessions to refine testing strategies and methodologies based on user input and
performance metrics.

projects.name: EFFICIENCY
details: DESCRIPTION
The UK's commitment to achieve net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 requires reducing heating emissions, facilitated by
effective home insulation in walls, floors, and roofs. The ECO Green Deal replaces earlier schemes, offering grants, loans, and
subsidies to enhance energy efficiency in homes. Energy companies like IEO serve as intermediaries, assisting homeowners in
qualifying for government-funded boiler replacements or upgrades to support these environmental goals.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Conducted comprehensive Smoke and Functional Testing to validate application functionality and user
requirements.
Engaged in Regression Testing and issue resolution, utilizing Jira for effective bug tracking and reporting.
Worked closely with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of features while maintaining high-quality
standards.
Prepared detailed test execution reports and participated in daily status calls with stakeholders to communicate progress and roadblocks.
